children: DayOne Data Centers filed for an initial public offering in the United States on Monday.
The filing comes as surging bond yields and elevated interest rates cloud the outlook for the fall IPO market.
Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, Citigroup are among the underwriters for the offering.
It plans to list its shares on Nasdaq under the symbol "DODC."
